caption:
5 signs that "ATO" message is a scam. Send this to someone who'd click.

The ATO says it will never:
1. Send an unsolicited SMS with a link in it.
2. Ask for your TFN, bank details or myGov login by email.
3. Threaten you with arrest or demand you stay on the line.
4. Ask for payment by gift cards, crypto or cash delivery.
5. Ask you to pay a fee to receive your refund.

Not sure if a message or call is real? Don't reply. Call the ATO on 1800 008 540 (check the number on ato.gov.au first), or log in to myGov yourself by typing the address, never through a link.

Scam messages spike around tax time and refund season.

Have you had one of these this year?

#scamalert #ato #mygov #taxreturn #australia
